scope: Capture acceptance and preliminary relative response, not a full dynamic-range or Adobe rendering study.
method: Blue Compressor native continuous RAW inverse transfer; no integer clipping, white balance, display curve, denoise or demosaic. G1/G2 averaged. Each clip has 8 black frames and 3 scene frames per aperture. Reference means subtract each clip and ROI observed 8-frame black mean. Highlight P50/P99 subtract the frame header black only; quantiles are per-channel spatial quantiles, then averaged. Integer ROI translations from median proxy registration; no pixel resampling. Aggregate differences are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
limits: SDR64 f4.5 and f4 have persistent excess response and prior aperture reversal; cannot treat the aperture label as proof of equal physical exposure.
Bright target has a spatial gradient, and there is camera movement. P99 is an upper-tail plateau, not proof that the whole ROI is saturated.
SDR64 has only one sampled aperture at the upper-tail plateau; exact clipping-EV and absolute DR are not established.
Eight-frame black data are used for offset correction only in this report. No absolute read-noise or DR result is reported.
Clip shutter metadata says 1/100s; provisional NRMT decoding gives about 1/90s for every clip. Actual shutter is not independently confirmed.
RAW-domain response similarity does not identify an analog gain circuit or establish Adobe ISO interpretation.
public_sample_rule: R3 identifies the new low-ISO capture. Values are unchanged; private original file identifiers are replaced.
